parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the certificate application repository.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the certificate application repository. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: ShowSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the certificate application repository. Valid values:

*   **ssl**: certificate application repository of SSL certificates
*   **uploadPCA**: certificate application repository of uploaded private certificates
*   **free**: certificate application repository of free certificates, available only on the China site (aliyun.com)
*   **aliyunPCA**: certificate application repository of private certificates purchased from Alibaba Cloud Private Certificate Authority (PCA), available only on the China site (aliyun.com)
*   **disable**: disabled certificate application repository

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cas list-cert-warehouse --name name --instance-id 14dcc8afc7578e1f --type aliyunPCA --current-page 1 --show-size 50 --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cas ListCertWarehouse --region cn-hangzhou --Type aliyunPCA --InstanceId 14dcc8afc7578e1f --CurrentPage 1 --ShowSize 50 --Name name
